LanguageData.Academic.degreeDatas.academic.label: academic
LanguageData.Academic.degreeDatas.academic.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] is a bit of an egg-head. [PAWN_pronoun] is more scientifically minded than most other colonists.
LanguageData.AnimalWhisperer.degreeDatas.animal_whisp: [PAWN_nameDef] is a natural at caring for animals. [PAWN_pronoun] always manages to get the most out of livestock.
LanguageData.Butcher.degreeDatas.butcher.label: butcher
LanguageData.Butcher.degreeDatas.butcher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] knows [PAWN_possessive] way around a cleaver. [PAWN_pronoun] can minimize wastage when butchering carcasses.
LanguageData.HighPainTolerance.degreeDatas.high_pain_: [PAWN_nameDef] has an unusually high tolerance of pain. It takes a lot to bring [PAWN_objective] down.
LanguageData.PreciseMiner.degreeDatas.precise_miner.d: [PAWN_nameDef] is a very good miner. [PAWN_pronoun] is able to extract more from mineral deposits and is faster at mining overall.
LanguageData.RadiationResistant.degreeDatas.radiation: [PAWN_nameDef]'s genetics make [PAWN_objective] more resistant to radiation than normal.
LanguageData.Sculptor.degreeDatas.sculptor.label: sculptor
LanguageData.Sculptor.degreeDatas.sculptor.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] is a natural at carving various materials.
[PAWN_nameDef] has a silver tongue and [PAWN_pronoun] is good at convincing others to get what [PAWN_pronoun] wants.
